run_en_de_teacher: run the EnDeTeacher class to load WMT English-German translation data for training
build_wmt_data: build and download the WMT14 English-German parallel corpus dataset using the build function
create_default_teacher: create a DefaultTeacher instance to access the WMT en-de translation task in ParlAI
read_parallel_files: read paired English and German sentence files into a list of tuples using readFiles
get_wmt_data_path: get the WMT task data file path for a given task name and datatype using _path
